== Title ==
<span lang="ja">トーントーン使い</span>. Three asterisks precede the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">騎乗する乗用生物の戦闘力に2を加える。トーントーンに乗っているなら、戦闘運命数を引けない場合に1枚引ける。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">コーマン・クィエンはエコー基地の偵察兵の典型と言える。野生のトーントーンを捕まえ、手なずけ、訓練を行うのだ。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Tauntaun Handler.

'''Lore''' — Corman Quien can be called a typical Echo Base scout. He captures, tames, and trains wild tauntauns.

'''Game text''' — Adds 2 to the power of a creature vehicle he rides. If riding a tauntaun, he may draw 1 battle destiny if not able to otherwise.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Three asterisks precede the title. Game text uses 騎乗する (rides) for creature vehicles, not “drives.” Lore is present tense and specifies wild tauntauns.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-tauntaunhandler-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Tauntaun Handler]].</ref>
